answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 11978 Country: India Title: what should a woman do if she feels wetness from her private part she has to only wazu only or she has to gassul before namaaz and also what she has do for her clothes before namaz she has to wash her clothes before her namaz Question: what should a woman do if she feels wetness from her private part she has to only wazu only or she has to gassul before namaaz and also what she has do for her clothes before namaz she has to wash her clothes before her namaz Answer ID: 11978 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 480/439=B/1430) If the wetness is inside the private part, she has to only clean it and perform wudhu; there is no need for a ghusl. If the wetness is on clothes, then the clothe must be washed, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
